translations.title: Bromelain 45 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to ease inflammation that comes with swelling, and swelling after injury or surgery.
translations.usage: Adults and children 12 or older take one to two tablets (45–90 mg) three times a day, with water, 30 minutes before meals. As how it works is not fully understood, do not take it without a clear reason.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have a severe blood clotting disorder, severe liver or kidney disease, if you are taking anticoagulants or antiplatelet medicines, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, if you are under 12, or if you have an inherited condition that prevents you from digesting lactose. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are taking antibiotics such as tetracycline, or have had an allergic reaction before.
